author: KEXP
description:
Reimagining the tropical traditions that link Mexico and Colombia, Mexican Institute of Sound and Meridian Brothers come together to create the joint project 'Ruido Rovar.' Layering psychedelic sounds and experimental electronics, the pair share a performance of "Ritmo Babilonia" and more Live on KEXP.

Watch: https://youtu.be/FnKf6kfO04Q
title: Mexican Institute of Soun d& Meridian Brothers perform "Ritmo Babilonia" & more Live on KEXP
